# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before changing methods or catalog data.

The product path is repo-root [ROADMAP.md](../ROADMAP.md). v1.2 launch (outreach, DNS, usdr.science marketing, arXiv submit) is parked. Do not do it.

Python is canonical. Browser pages are demos.

Never set catalog status to confirmed. Never invent RESULT: CONFIRMED or RESULT: INCONCLUSIVE. A result must come from a real run.

Do not loosen the habitat finite-size gate (NU_TOLERANCE 0.15, nu within 15% of 4/3).

Do not promote Wave Factory bridges. Harvested `u-gap-*` unknowns are the only auto-landed catalog rows, and only Night Crew does that.

Visitor pages (`dashboard/index.html`, `repro/*/index.html`, explainers) must not say YAML, clone, fork, pull request, or CI. Those words stay in operator docs.

One issue or one page per session. Open a pull request. Do not merge it.

Pick `status:needs-owner` issues. Skip issues whose roadmap item is already checked in `.planning/ROADMAP.md`.
